## Adding my profile card

**My card:** `members/<your-name>.md`

### Checklist
- [ ] I only added or changed **my own** file in `members/`
- [ ] The file name is lowercase with hyphens, e.g. `aisha-bello.md`
- [ ] `name`, `github`, `level`, `department` and `track` are filled in
- [ ] There's no phone number, email or reg number in my card
- [ ] I've reviewed (or will review) at least one teammate's PR

### For reviewers
Read the card under **Files changed**, leave at least one comment, then **Approve** if the checklist is met.
